#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    int am;
    std::string zad;
    std::cin >> am >> zad;

    std::string s = zad;
    std::string skobki = "_";
    int str = -1;
    int len = s.length();

    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            str = i;
        }
        if (c == ')') {
            skobki += s.substr(str + 1, i - (str + 1)) + "_";
            s = s.substr(0, str) + "_" + s.substr(i + 1);
            len = s.length();
            i = str - 1;
            str = -1;
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> arr;
    std::stringstream ss(skobki);
    std::string token;
    while (std::getline(ss, token, '_')) {
        arr.push_back(token);
    }

    int count = 0;
    for (const auto& item : arr) {
        if (!item.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }

    // Split s by '_'
    std::vector<std::string> arr2;
    std::stringstream ss2(s);
    while (std::getline(ss2, token, '_')) {
        arr2.push_back(token);
    }

    int max_len = 0;
    for (const auto& item : arr2) {
        if (item.length() > max_len) {
            max_len = item.length();
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_len << " " << count << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
